module: Manager of a loaded rally mission (special stage or road section). A RallyManager object groups the notebook (pacenotes), the race path (race.json), the recorded driveline (DrivelineV3 / DrivelineRoute), vehicle tracking (VehicleTracker), the audio manager, the pacenote queue, the stage observer (StageObserver) and the timer (StageTimingState). It triggers the audio and visual pacenotes, handles vehicle recoveries, split times and the stage state for the UI. It is created and owned by the gameplay_rally extension (gameplay_rally.getRallyManager()). The module returns a constructor.
usage:
local rm = gameplay_rally.getRallyManager()
if rm then
  local data = rm:getActiveStageData()
  print(data.currentSSTime, data.completion.distPct)
end
notes: The constructor is called with (missionDir, missionId); the resources (notebook, driveline, audio) are only built by rebuildAssets.
The pacenote queue (dequeue) can contain the special value 'HOLD': while it is at the head, no pacenote is played. It is used for slow corners (slowCorner) and released by clearQueueHold.
The activation parameters are read from settings: rallyAudioPacenotes and rallyVisualPacenotes. A notebook in custom audio mode does not emit visual pacenotes.
Timer authority modes: 'shadow' (default, source = 'race' race data) or 'tracker' (source = crossing observer). Any other value falls back to 'shadow'.

Vehicle recoveries call extensions.hook('onVehicleTeleportedToLastRoad', vehId); recoverVehicleToRouteDeparture also calls extensions.hook('onRallyRouteRecoveryComplete', {vehId, repairVehicle, recoveryData}).
getActiveStageData always returns the same reused table (module local variable): copy the values if they must be kept between two calls.

Potential bug: several methods do not check that drivelineRoute exists (getPointDistanceFromStartMeters/Km, getRaceCompletionData) and raise an error on nil before loading; getTimeAllocationSecs divides by drivelineV3:getSpeedLimitKph() without testing for a nil or zero value; codriver and closestPacenoteToVehicle assume notebook / vehicleTracker are non-nil.
addRecoveryRaceTime always uses the penalties of a special stage ("Single stages are always a special stage", code comment) and ignores the non-special-stage penalties table of recoveryClockAdvance.

C.desc: RallyManager object returned by the module's constructor.

init.desc: Initializes all fields (pacenote queue, notebook, racePath, driveline, audio nil, StageObserver, StageTimingState, authority mode 'shadow') for the given mission.

getVoicepackPickWritesSettings.desc: Indicates whether the voicepack choice is written to the settings (true unless explicitly disabled).

_refreshNotebookForVoicepackPick.desc: Invalidates the notebook's voicepack and custom audio caches and notifies it of a settings change.

setVoicepackPick.desc: Sets the session voicepack (type 'auto' converted to 'preferences'), adds it to the MRU list if needed, then refreshes the notebook unless deferNotebookRefresh.

getErrorMsgForUser.desc: Last error message intended for the user (missing race.json, invalid notebook, etc.).

getPacenoteProcessingEnabled.desc: Indicates whether pacenote queue processing is active.

setPacenoteProcessingEnabled.desc: Enables or suspends pacenote queue processing.

getNotebookPath.desc: Loaded notebook (NotebookPath object), nil before rebuildAssets.

getRaceData.desc: Current race data (vehicle states, times), provided by setRaceData.

getStartPositionByName.desc: Looks for a start position of the race path by its name.

getSSStartLinePos.desc: Start position named "SS_start_line" (special stage start line).

getMissionName.desc: Translated name of the mission, computed once then cached.

getMissionStartTrigger.desc: Start trigger (startTrigger) of the mission in gameplay_missions_missions; nil and a logged error if the mission is not found.

triggerPacenote.desc: Plays a pacenote if playback is allowed: sends it to the audio (rallyAudioPacenotes setting) and triggers the visual display (rallyVisualPacenotes setting, except for a custom audio notebook).

_playbackAllowed.desc: Calls pacenote:playbackAllowed(); on error, the error is logged and playback is allowed.

setupDrivelineRouteHooks.desc: Wires up the DrivelineRoute callbacks (CsDynamic, CsImmediate, CsStatic, CeStatic, -40 offsets for Cs and -5 for Ce, corner percentage 0.5): they queue the pacenote, add a HOLD for slow corners, clear the visual pacenote and release the HOLD according to the pacenote's rule.

getPointDistanceFromStartMeters.desc: Distance of the point from the start along the road, in meters.

point.desc: Road point or position (inferred from code)

getPointDistanceFromStartKm.desc: Distance of the point from the start along the road, in kilometers.

point.desc: Road point or position (inferred from code)

getTimeAllocationSecs.desc: Time allocated in seconds to travel the road at the driveline's speed limit (distance / speed).

returns.desc: seconds; nil if road/driveline absent or negative distance

getTimeAllocationString.desc: Allocated time rounded up to the next minute, in the format "Xh Ym".

getSplitDataList.desc: List of the DrivelineRoute's splits data.

getSplitDataIndex.desc: Index of the splits by pathnodeId.

getPathnodeObservationList.desc: List ordered by distance of the pathnodes to observe (splits, finish).

resolveAndLoadNotebook.desc: Chooses the active voicepack (exact choice or preferences/MRU) then loads the mission's matching notebook. If none exists, returns an empty in-memory notebook ("Route Preview") to preview a route without pacenotes.

rebuildAssets.desc: Builds the whole runtime context: VehicleTracker, race.json, notebook, AudioManager, driveline (DrivelineV3) and DrivelineRoute, notebook snaproad, compiled pacenotes, then runtimeResync. On failure, errorMsgForUser is set.

reloadVoicepackAssets.desc: Changes the voicepack then rebuilds all the compositor-derived states (including the distance calls).

resetStageRuntime.desc: Resets the stage tracking state: timer, observer, end flags, and reapplies the authority mode to the observer.

resetPacenoteRuntime.desc: Clears the visual pacenotes, the audio queue and the pacenote queue.

resyncAfterTeleport.desc: Resynchronizes the state after a vehicle move: empties the queues, forgets the observer's footprint and asks the DrivelineRoute to recompute (immediately if deferRuntime == false, otherwise at the next onUpdate).

clearResolvedAudioObjs.desc: Asks the notebook to forget the resolved audio objects.

runtimeResync.desc: Clears the resolved audio, resets the stage timer, then calls resyncAfterTeleport.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Called when the rally settings change: notifies the notebook and empties the audio queue.

setPreserveRecoveryTrackerOnNextVehicleR.desc: Indicates that the next vehicle reset must preserve the recovery's static tracking.

val.desc: true to preserve (only the strict value true counts)

onVehicleResetted.desc: Called when the vehicle is put back in place: clears the resolved audio and resyncs (preserving the recovery tracker once only if requested).

triggerShowVisualPacenote.desc: Sends the compiled pacenote to the UI via guihooks 'showVisualPacenote2'. Ignored if it has no visual event or no icon (empty visualPacenotes).

triggerClearVisualPacenote.desc: Clears one visual pacenote (guihooks 'clearOneVisualPacenote' with visualSerialNo).

drawPacenotesForDriving.desc: Debug-draws the next pacenote: the corner start waypoint with the compiled text.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame by gameplay_rally: updates the tracker, the DrivelineRoute, the timer (advances by dtSim), the split observations, the audio, then processes the pacenote queue.

clearQueueHold.desc: Removes the HOLD at the head of the pacenote queue, if it is there.

enqueuePacenote.desc: Adds a pacenote to the end of the queue.

enqueueHold.desc: Adds a HOLD value to the end of the queue: the following pacenotes wait for its release.

processPacenoteQueue.desc: If processing is active and the head is not HOLD, dequeues a pacenote and plays it via triggerPacenote.

closestPacenoteToVehicle.desc: Pacenote closest to the tracked vehicle's position.

getNextPacenotes.desc: List containing the driveline's next pacenote (a single element, possibly nil).

enqueueRandomSystemPacenote.desc: Picks a random system pacenote by name, reads the audio duration from its metadata (+ audioLenOffset) and sends it to the AudioManager. Logs an error if the name, the audio file or the duration are invalid.

audioLenOffset.desc: Seconds added to the audio duration (0 by default)

enqueuePauseSecs.desc: Adds a pause to the audio queue.

sendPacenoteToAudioManager.desc: Sends the pacenote to the AudioManager for audio playback.

returns.desc: false if there is no AudioManager

playFirstPacenote.desc: Plays (audio) the notebook's first sorted pacenote and stores it as the last played.

setLastPlayedPacenote.desc: Stores the last played pacenote, its name and its index in the notebook's sorted list.

getLastPlayedPacenote.desc: Last played pacenote (retrieved by its index in the notebook if it exists).

getLastPlayedPacenoteRecoveryPose.desc: Computes a recovery position and rotation placed before the last played pacenote.

distanceBefore.desc: Distance before the pacenote, in meters (inferred from code)

recoverVehicleToLastPlayedPacenote.desc: Teleports the vehicle 10 m (or options.distanceBefore) before the last played pacenote, resyncs then triggers the onVehicleTeleportedToLastRoad hook.

getRouteDepartureRecoveryPose.desc: Computes the recovery pose after leaving the road (DrivelineRoute:vehiclePlacementPosAndRotForRecovery).

recoverVehicleToRouteDeparture.desc: Teleports the vehicle to the road's resume point, with repair according to options.repairVehicle / resetVehicle / gameplay_rally.getRecoveryRepairVehicle (true by default), then triggers the onVehicleTeleportedToLastRoad and onRallyRouteRecoveryComplete hooks.

getRecoveryDestinationPos.desc: Destination position of a recovery: the resume pose, otherwise the road point ahead of the vehicle.

getLiaisonAllocatedTimeSecs.desc: Time allocated for the road section in seconds.

hasAnyPacenotes.desc: Indicates whether the notebook contains pacenotes.

getStartAndFinishStartPositions.desc: Returns the start position (SS_start_line, otherwise TC_in) and the last pathnode (flying finish, not the stop control).

getRaceDistanceMeters.desc: Race distance between start and finish along the driveline.

getRaceCompletionData.desc: Race progress: distM (distance in m) and distPct (0 to 1); the code also reads totalDistM.

setStageRuntimeAuthorityMode.desc: Sets the timer authority mode ('tracker' or 'shadow') and passes it to the observer.

setStageRuntimeActive.desc: Starts or stops the stage timer; does not start if the stage is already finished.

getStageRuntimeTime.desc: Special stage time in seconds: the tracker's finish time if it exists, otherwise the timer's time.

addRecoveryRaceTime.desc: Adds a recovery's penalty to the timer (RecoveryClockAdvance.getSpecialStageSeconds).

returns.desc: true if time was added (false if 0 s or timer inactive)

sampleRaceStageTime.desc: Special stage time for a vehicle: the timer's if active or finished by the tracker, otherwise that of the race data (finish time if finished).

getTrackerStageTime.desc: Special stage time as seen by the tracker: observer, otherwise tracker finish, active timer, or race time.

updateTrackerSplitObservations.desc: Calls StageObserver:update with the static tracker, the observation nodes and the frame times, then copies the stage end and ends the timer if the observer detected the finish.

getActiveStageData.desc: Builds the special stage state for the UI: currentSSTime (seconds to the tenth), isActive, isComplete, splits, authorityMode, source ('race', 'tracker' or 'trackerFallback'), completion {distPct, totalDistM}. Depends on the authority mode and the observer state.

returns.desc: Reused shared table; nil without vehicleTracker

recordSplit.desc: Records a race's time for a split (via the observer, or directly in splitData).

clearSplitTimes.desc: Clears all the splits' times and observation markers then resets the stage timer.

getLoopPrefabPath.desc: Path of the loopPrefab.prefab.json file in the mission folder.
